name: Rocco
description: An elf bartender at the cabaret who refuses to help Elspeth.

timeline.summary: Dressed in Xander's tailored outfit, Elspeth visits a Cabaretti cabaret looking for work and is rebuffed by the bartender Rocco.
timeline.quote: Rocco gave her a look that said, Who do you think you are? and promptly walked away.
